timeline.summary: Garth finds leaving his powers behind hard and resumes journeying between planes; Norreen and Hammen are kidnapped to Benalia.
timeline.quote: Norreen and Hammen were kidnapped and brought to Benalia

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garth attacks Gull and Greensleeves believing they were the kidnappers, then is calmed and promises never to abandon his family.
timeline.quote: Garth admitted the wrongness of his ways

citation.text: "Garth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard breaks up a fight in the Benalish training yard by shooting Torsten.
timeline.quote: Gerrard breaks up the fight by threatening and ultimately shooting Torsten in the leg with a longbow.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Gerrard's Tale", by Michael Ryan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torsten dies after attacking Gerrard with a poisoned dagger and the Null Rod.
timeline.quote: Torsten makes a last-ditch attempt to kill Gerrard but uses the Null Rod, remembering it from the demonstration on his first day.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Gerrard's Tale", by Michael Ryan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alaric kills himself with the poisoned wine at Gerrard's suggestion.
timeline.quote: Alaric, at his former friend Gerrard's suggestion, decides to kill himself with the wine to save his reputation.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Gerrard's Tale", by Michael Ryan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard rejoins the Weatherlight and appoints Tahngarth first mate.
timeline.quote: Gerrard is introduced to old and new crewmates and appoints Tahngarth as the first mate

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Gerrard's Tale", by Michael Ryan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Benalia becomes the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's Phyrexian slayers.
timeline.quote: Benalia was only the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's specialized killers.

citation.text: Phyrexian Slayer (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Benalia is the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's killers during the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion , Benalia was the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc 's specialized killers.

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Benalia, Pol Cordel tells Gerrard that a Talruum has arrived aboard a flying ship, and Gerrard guesses Sisay has come for him.
timeline.quote: "You think she's come looking for me."

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard recalls that chasing the Legacy cost the lives of friends and is why he left the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: chasing after the Legacy cost the lives of friends.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Cordel's argument persuades Gerrard to go and see the docks.
timeline.quote: All right then. A convincing argument at last. Which docks?

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard hears Tahngarth roaring at a missionary of the Church of Angelfire on the docks and runs to calm him.
timeline.quote: "Uh oh," Gerrard murmured, and broke into a run.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard talks Tahngarth out of killing the missionary, and the two are reunited.
timeline.quote: "Easy, Tahngarth," he murmured, taking the Talruum's arm.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth tells Gerrard they came to find him because something terrible has happened to Sisay.
timeline.quote: something terrible has happened.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard decides to return to the Weatherlight the next morning, with Cordel arguing he should help his friends.
timeline.quote: Tomorrow morning I'm going back to the Weatherlight

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard leaves his hourglass pendant, the only part of the Legacy he kept, in Cordel's keeping.
timeline.quote: This belonged to my parents.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight, with Gerrard aboard, sets sail from Benalia.
timeline.quote: The following morning, the Weatherlight , with Gerrard aboard, set sail from Benalia.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Torsten von Ursus founds Benalia at the blighted city of Benfosa.
timeline.quote: The knight Torsten von Ursus , in exile since an evil mage conquered his homeland of Wrenna , founded Benalia at the spot of the blighted city of Benfosa

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Birth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Torsten dies leaving the Lost Edict forbidding a sole ruler.
timeline.quote: After succeeding in much of his goal, he died at the age of seventy-two, leaving behind the legendary Lost Edict

citation.text: "Benalia", section "The Lost Edict". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The city is rebuilt as New Benalia from the white limestone of fallen buildings.
timeline.quote: Using the white limestone of fallen buildings, the city was rebuilt as New Benalia.

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Renewal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Cabal's expansion corrupts the great expanses of the empire.
timeline.quote: However, the expansion of The Cabal corrupted the great expanses of the empire.

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Influence of the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana destroys the lich of her brother.
timeline.quote: The enraged Lich left his hideout to confront her, only for Liliana to destroy him.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Return to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Oyster Bay summit Aron, found compleated, is killed by his daughter Danitha.
timeline.quote: Houses Capashen and Tarmula joined to rescue Aron, but when it was discovered that he had already been compleated, he was killed by his daughter, Danitha .

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the second Phyrexian Invasion, Orvada's merchant lords make peace with Benalia and supply Lyra's Serran troops.
timeline.quote: After the second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria, the merchant lords of Orvada made peace with Benalia and furnished food and supplies to the Serran troops led by Lyra Dawnbringer.

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sleeper agents abduct Aron Capashen at the Oyster Bay peace summit; Ertai oversees his compleation.
timeline.quote: Aron's compleation was personally overseen by Ertai

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The compleated Aron fights at Aerona and is slain by his daughter Danitha, who takes over House Capashen.
timeline.quote: he was confronted and ultimately slain by his grieving daughter, Danitha Capashen

citation.text: "Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, envy of House Capashen causes a civil war that drives them into the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Later, the various houses of Benalia began envying House Capashen, the mightiest at the time, leading to a civil war that forced the Capashens into hiding, eventually joining the Cabal .

citation.text: "Benalia", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, Benalia attacks Llanowar during the second Brothers' War, forcing the elves to mechanize and cut down the forest.
timeline.quote: Benalia attacked Llanowar while expanding their borders.

citation.text: "Llanowar", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avenant is lost to Benalia after an insult by an unwise clan leader (said by some to be a Clan Ternsev leader who kidnapped an Avenant prince's daughter).
timeline.quote: Avenant once formed a part of Benalia, but it was lost after an insult by an unwise clan leader

citation.text: "Avenant", section "Clan Avenant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Mending Era Avenant rejoins Benalia, replacing Clan Ternsev as the seventh Great House.
timeline.quote: replacing Clan Ternsev as the seventh Great House

citation.text: "Avenant", section "Clan Avenant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Benalia is the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc's specialized killers in the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Benalia was the first nation victimized by Tsabo Tavoc 's specialized killers.

citation.text: "Benalia City", section "Invaded by Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serranism is banned in Benalia for centuries after its founding.
timeline.quote: Serranism was banned in that nation for centuries

citation.text: "Church of Serra", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Refugees from Serra's Realm revive the Church in Benalia.
timeline.quote: the Church of Serra experienced a revival in Benalia

citation.text: "Church of Serra", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza chooses Clan Capashen for his Bloodline Project.
timeline.quote: chose Clan Capashen to become part of his Bloodline Project

citation.text: "Clan Capashen", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ellyn saves Purceon from a Phyrexian attack and is appointed soldier.
timeline.quote: Appointed Ellyn Capashen as a soldier after she saved him from a Phyrexian attack

citation.text: "Clan Capashen", section "Members". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Raddeus and Leda are killed by Tsabo Tavoc's minions and reanimated as skeletons.
timeline.quote: Killed by Tsabo Tavoc 's minions

citation.text: "Clan Capashen", section "Members". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Danitha refuses Jhoira's request to join the new Weatherlight crew; Raff goes in her stead.
timeline.quote: Danitha refused Jhoira 's request to become part of the new Weatherlight crew

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse Danitha becomes Belzenlok's right hand and leads his forces against Benalia.
timeline.quote: Danitha has taken up her father's role as the right hand of Belzenlok

citation.text: "Danitha Capashen", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norreen chooses to become a hero above Benalia's caste system, serving as squire to the warlord Alaqua.
timeline.quote: she served as squire to the warlord Alaqua

citation.text: "Norreen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norreen and Hammen are kidnapped and taken to Benalia while Garth is away.
timeline.quote: Norreen and Hammen were kidnapped and brought to Benalia

citation.text: "Norreen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norreen becomes Gull's lover and army commander, then attempts suicide, is tortured and saved by Lily and Gull.
timeline.quote: She was captured and tortured before being saved by Lily and Gull.

citation.text: "Norreen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the second Phyrexian Invasion, Orvada's merchant lords negotiate peace with Benalia and supply the Serran hosts of Lyra Dawnbringer.
timeline.quote: Orvada's powerful merchant lords negotiated a fragile peace with Benalia

citation.text: "Orvada", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Benalia tries to extend influence into the mountains around 4068 AR and is defeated by dwarven warriors, losing Alaqua.
timeline.quote: The Benalish were defeated by dwarven warriors

citation.text: "Red Iron Mountains", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tsabo fights Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew twice during the attack on Benalia.
timeline.quote: Tsabo fought Gerrard Capashen and the rest of the Weatherlight crew twice during the attack on Benalia

citation.text: "Tsabo Tavoc", section "Storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
